none: PAS NLM-B258C2: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus commemorating Constantine I (306-337), quadriga ascending issue of 337-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Veiled bust right. Obverse inscription: [--]STANTI[--]. Reverse description: Quadriga galloping right, hand of God above. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 13.1mm, Weight: 1.14gms, die axis: 6
